confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are the most reliable; July peak-season hotel and hostel rates are less certain. EUR-to-USD conversion assumes about 1.16. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer price (cocktail about three times a draft beer, wine glass about one beer) because direct knowledge of those is weaker. FX is the latest RBA observation I could verify (13 Oct 2026), taken from search-result text for the RBA overview page rather than a direct page read; a 14 Oct reading was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; benchmarked against other large Southern European capitals with heavy summer tourism, such as Lisbon and Barcelona, using general knowledge of local pricing.
